description: List opportunities (pipeline deals) in Close. Returns a `data` array of opportunities with id, lead_id, status, value, currency, confidence, and expected close date, plus `has_more` / `total_results`. Pass `lead_id` to scope to one lead, or omit to list across the organization. Page with `_limit` / `_skip`.

_skip.description: Number of results to skip for pagination (default 0)

lead_id.description: Optional lead ID to filter opportunities to a single lead

name: close_list_opportunities
title: Close List Opportunities
